interfaces.name: light-sensor
interfaces.description: Light sensors report illuminance. Use the reading to understand ambient light and provide input to a lighting automation.

value.description:
The illuminance value is a number between 1 and 65533. This attribute SHALL indicate the illuminance in Lux (symbol lx) as follows:
  • MeasuredValue = 10,000 x log10(illuminance) + 1,
    where 1 lx <= illuminance <= 3.576 Mlx, corresponding to a MeasuredValue in the range 1 to 0xFFFE.
    The MeasuredValue attribute can take the following values:
  • 0 indicates a value of illuminance that is too low to be measured,
  • MinMeasuredValue <= MeasuredValue <= MaxMeasuredValue under normal circumstances,
  • null indicates that the illuminance measurement is invalid.
    The MeasuredValue attribute is updated continuously as new measurements are made

interfaces.description: Smoke and carbon monoxide detectors report detection state. Devices expose alarm controls through the alarm capability and charge level through the battery capability.

interfaces.name: snapshot
interfaces.description: Snapshots request a captured view and return a snapshot response. Use them when an integration needs a single capture rather than a continuous live view.

value.description: A snapshot value with URI and expiration

interfaces.description: Soil moisture measurements report the reading supplied by a connected sensor. Use the value as input when monitoring growing conditions.

value.description: A measurement value with optional null support

isNull.description: True if the measurement is invalid/null

value.title: MeasurementValue

interfaces.description: Descriptive spatial declaration of a group route (home, floor/map, room or zone). The spatial interface declares no control messages; cleaning is sent to the robot endpoint.

attributes.description: Whether this map or floor is the provider's currently loaded map (maps only)

schema.description: Whether this map or floor is the provider's currently loaded map (maps only)

attributes.name: geometry

schema.description: Observed area of the group route in the coordinate system of its reference frame

shape.description: Area covered by a group route, as a polygon or multi-polygon

oneOf.description: GeoJSON-like polygon: an exterior ring followed by optional interior rings (holes)

items.description: A closed ring of positions; the first and last positions are equal (GeoJSON linear ring)
A position as [x, y] or [x, y, z] in the frame's coordinate system

oneOf.title: SpatialMultiPolygon

relativeToGroupId.description: Canonical endpoint group whose frame the coordinates use

relativeToGroupRouteId.description: Provider group route whose coordinate system the coordinates use

observedAt.description: When the provider observed this geometry

coordinateSystem.description: Coordinate system of a provider frame. Declared only where the provider's units and axes are proven.

interfaces.name: speaker
interfaces.description: Speakers set or adjust volume and change mute state. Read the current volume and mute state to keep playback controls in step with the device.

interfaces.name: speech-audio-generation
interfaces.description: Speech audio generation turns an input into speech audio and returns its URI. Use the result when an integration needs an audio file it can pass to a player.

uri.description: URL of the generated audio resource

mimeType.description: MIME type of the audio resource (e.g., audio/mpeg)

durationMs.description: Duration of the generated audio in milliseconds

text.description: The text content to synthesize into speech audio

speakerEmbeddingUrl.description: URL or base64 data URI of the speaker embedding for voice characteristics

interfaces.name: speech-synthesizer
interfaces.description: Speech synthesizers accept a request to speak. Use them to send spoken output to a connected device or integration.

cannedTtsStringId.description: Provider-defined canned speech identifier; supported only by integrations advertising canned speech.

configuration.description: Speech synthesizers accept a request to speak. Use them to send spoken output to a connected device or integration.

interfaces.name: temperature-sensor
interfaces.description: Temperature sensors report temperature and operation mode. Use the reading to display conditions or give a heating and cooling flow a measured input.

interfaces.name: text
interfaces.description: Text sends a text message to a connected component. Use it to pass written input between integrations.

text.description: The text content of the message

interfaces.name: text-stream
interfaces.description: Text streams emit text as a stream of messages. Use the stream to consume output as it becomes available.

streamId.description: Unique identifier for this text stream

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID for this text stream

isFinal.description: Whether this is the final chunk in the stream

maxChunkSize.description: Maximum size for individual text chunks

maxStreamLength.description: Maximum total length for text streams

legacyMode.description: Whether to use legacy mode for compatibility

chunkTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for chunk delivery

configuration.description: Text streams emit text as a stream of messages. Use the stream to consume output as it becomes available.

lowerSetpoint.description: A temperature setpoint with value and scale

configuration.description: Thermostats set a target temperature and select a heating or cooling mode. Read the reported setpoints and operating mode to show the current settings.

interfaces.name: water-heater
interfaces.description: Water heaters set a temperature and operating mode. Read the temperature setpoint and mode to show the settings supplied by a connected heater.

configuration.description: Water heaters set a temperature and operating mode. Read the temperature setpoint and mode to show the settings supplied by a connected heater.

interfaces.name: wind-speed-sensor
interfaces.description: Wind speed measurements report the reading supplied by a connected sensor. Use the value and its declared unit when displaying measured wind conditions.

value.description: A measurement value with optional null support

isNull.description: True if the measurement is invalid/null

interfaces.name: window
interfaces.description: Windows report their window state and lock state. Use those reports to check the status supplied by a connected window.
